heroDescription: Learn riichi mahjong scoring step by step, from counting fu to calling out the final score. A training app built for beginners.
practiceDescription: Practice menus for every level, from simple fu calculations and counting the han of a whole hand to full, game-style score calculation.
referenceDescription: A scoring table, a yaku list and a glossary. They are linked to every part of the app, so when you get a question wrong you can look up the correct score right away.
learnDescription: A structured curriculum that lets you start even if you know nothing about scoring yet.
appDescription: Practice, lessons and rank exams on your iPhone too. Sign in with the same account you use on the web, and your records and rank carry over as they are.
